name: Pécsbagota (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of green over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pécsbagota (a green shield with an owl, a wavy white stripe and a swan, within a wreath of grain) above a scroll inscribed Pécsbagota.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pécsbagota arms with wreath and scroll
